---
title: "4 · CNNs, Class Activation Maps, Adversarial Examples and the 2D Ising Model"
code-tools: false
toc: false
---

CIFAR-10 with dense and convolutional networks: convolution, continuous and discrete, kernels and Sobel filters, stride, padding, channels and pooling, and regularisation with L1/L2 penalties, dropout and batch normalisation. Class activation maps and Grad-CAM show where a CNN looks; adversarial examples, from the fast gradient sign method to the one-pixel attack, show where it fails; the optimisers from stochastic gradient descent to Adam, under the hood. The 2D Ising model: the partition function, the 1D chain and Onsager's solution in 2D, criticality, Metropolis sampling of spin configurations, and a CNN trained far from the transition whose prediction confidence drops at the critical temperature.
